# Bundled KaTeX distribution

- Version: 0.18.4
- Source: <https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/tag/v0.18.4>
- Release archive SHA-256: `a3602aeaca15779474b34babd75481c5251a7f78e68241a1b68d8fe2cec043eb`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

Register bundles `katex.min.js`, `katex-swap.min.css`, and the release fonts. They are loaded from
the local installation only after a rendered page or editor preview contains a formula.
